objects.description: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has used tcping.exe, similar to [Ping](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0097), to probe port status on systems of interest.(Citation: PWC Cloud Hopper Technical Annex April 2017)
